vulnerabilities.summary: FastAPI ReDoS and header parsing vulnerability in multipart form handlers
vulnerabilities.details: A regular expression denial of service vulnerability exists in form-data parser.

vulnerabilities.summary: SQLAdmin Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in model view column rendering
vulnerabilities.details: Improper escaping in HTML columns allows injected script execution in administrative panel.

vulnerabilities.summary: Starlette multipart form parser resource consumption vulnerability
vulnerabilities.details: Malformed headers in multipart uploads can consume excessive CPU resources.

vulnerabilities.summary: aiohttp HTTP Request Smuggling via malformed chunk extensions
vulnerabilities.details: Improper chunk handling in aiohttp HTTP server allows request smuggling.
